name: poll_events_then_init
description: Polls an indirect check routine until it reports ready, then, when a state counter is minus one, runs a fixed series of indirect calls and a three-step loop of indirect handlers before waiting again. The indirect targets are unresolved in the decompilation, so the specific actions cannot be recovered.

name: reply_exec_message_and_poll
description: Returns a message to its sender through the exec library reply call and runs a polling and sequencing loop that calls four further routines. The loop body mirrors its neighbour's control flow, so only the message reply is certain from the evidence.

name: flip_double_buffer_frame
description: Swaps pairs of saved state words to alternate between two buffers, advances a buffer pointer by a fixed stride, and scans a byte row counting non-zero entries above and below five. It takes and replies exec messages and calls the graphics library to copy memory, blit bitmaps and move sprites.

name: check_window_hit_then_dispatch
description: Clears a flag, lowers a level counter with a floor of five, and loops over two counters and a timing word. When the current position falls inside a target window it dispatches through a jump table indexed by a stored value, and otherwise keeps scanning.

name: insert_into_sorted_ten_list
description: Recomputes a speed-derived value from a table entry and, when a countdown reaches zero, may swap two saved pairs. It inserts a value into a sorted list of ten words by shifting larger entries down, then calls routines to emit output.

name: set_clamped_step_and_swap
description: Adds a fixed offset to a position word, then loops four times deriving a value from a table entry's speed word, clamped to a range and reduced by two. It sets a high bit on a state word and runs the buffer swap sequence.

name: reset_hit_tracking_and_scan
description: Increments a counter, clears several hit-tracking words, and releases a pending slot if one is set. It then runs the window scan that dispatches through a jump table when the position lies inside the target window.

name: set_flag_and_scan_window
description: Sets a flag word to one, then runs the window scan that dispatches through a jump table when a position falls inside the target window. When no slot is pending it advances a delay counter and calls routines.

name: advance_scale_and_scan_window
description: When a step counter is below two, increments it, doubles a scale value that resets to 41 once it reaches 40, and releases any pending slot. It then runs the window scan that dispatches through a jump table.

name: set_secondary_flag_and_scan
description: Sets a secondary flag word to one, then runs the same window scan that dispatches through a jump table when a position falls inside the target window. The scan also advances a delay counter when no slot is pending.

name: set_slot_flag_and_scan
description: Sets a slot flag word to one, then runs the window scan that dispatches through a jump table when a position falls inside the target window. The scan also handles a pending slot and advances a delay counter when no slot is pending.

name: set_status_flag_and_scan
description: Sets a status flag word to one, then runs the window scan that dispatches through a jump table when a position falls inside the target window. Its exit path matches the other scan routines in this group.

name: remap_row_byte_codes
description: Walks a byte row and rewrites each value above four: five becomes zero, seven becomes three, eleven becomes two, and any other value becomes ten. It advances a position counter until it passes a limit, then runs the window scan.

name: fill_row_codes_with_limit
description: Writes a code into a byte row and steps along it, choosing three for seven, two for eleven and ten for other values, and restarts the cycle when a five is read. It stops when a position counter passes a limit, then runs the window scan.

name: write_row_codes_from_two
description: Writes a code of two into a byte row and steps along it, cycling each stored code through its replacement sequence until a position limit is reached. It then runs the window scan.

name: write_row_codes_and_blit
description: Writes replacement codes along a byte row starting from three and cycles them until a position limit is reached. The routine also calls the graphics library bit-map blit and runs the window scan.

name: set_flags_and_scan_window
description: Sets two flag words to one, then runs the window scan that dispatches through a jump table when a position falls inside the target window.

name: cycle_table_value_and_scan
description: When a flag is clear and a table entry is set, steps a four-value counter that selects one of four table entries, skipping zero entries and wrapping at the end of its cycle. Otherwise it calls two routines, and it then runs the window scan.

name: select_table_value_by_counter
description: Chooses a working value from one of several table entries according to a step counter, skipping zero entries and resetting the counter at the end of its cycle. It then calls a routine.

name: select_alternate_table_value
description: Chooses a working value from a different set of table entries according to a step counter, with a fallback entry when the chosen one is zero and a counter reset at the end of its cycle. It then calls a routine.

name: pick_next_nonzero_table_value
description: Selects a working value from a table entry by stepping a counter through four entries, skipping any entry that is zero, and restarting the cycle at the end. It then calls a routine.

name: call_two_routines_then_scan
description: Calls two routines and then runs the window scan that dispatches through a jump table when a position falls inside the target window.

name: halve_scale_and_release_slot
description: When a counter is not minus one, decrements it, halves a scale value, and sets a flag word to one. It also releases any pending slot by storing minus one in the slot word.

name: store_minus_one_state_word
description: Stores minus one in a state word and does nothing else. It is a single-instruction routine.

name: allocate_sprites_and_audio_resources
description: Allocates three sprites and opens the audio device, reporting an error message for either failure. On exit it frees and closes the sprites, ports, signals, fonts and interrupt servers it uses, and calls wrappers that close the screen and window.

name: draw_mega_title_text
description: Sets the drawing mode, clears a rast, and draws the text MEGA with the graphics text call. It also blits bit maps and moves sprites through a sequence of indirect calls.

name: drain_port_messages_and_reply
description: Repeatedly takes messages from a port through an indirect call and replies to each one until none remain. The facts also list screen, palette and pointer setup calls to the intuition and graphics libraries.

name: poll_messages_until_flag_set
description: Drains a message port, replying to each message, and records a flag when a message has one bit set. It also copies a byte from a message when a second bit is set and loops until the flag is non-zero.

name: update_bounded_motion_with_timers
description: Counts down a timer and, when it expires, reloads it from a value derived from a speed word and calls routines. It reverses a direction word when a position leaves a bounded range, and it sums a run of twenty bytes.

name: delegate_sprite_and_blit_update
description: Calls an indirect routine that the library facts link to blitting and sprite movement, then replies to a message. The recovered body shows only that one indirect call before returning, so the detailed work is not visible.

name: check_grid_cell_hit_sequence
description: Maps a position to a cell in a 20-column grid using fixed cell sizes and returns early for out-of-range or empty cells. For a cell value of five it counts consecutive hits up to six and compares the current position with the saved one, then sets timing and state words when the sequence repeats.

name: advance_grid_cell_state
description: Maps a position to a cell in a grid and returns if the position is outside the grid or the cell is empty. It advances the cell's stored code by one, skipping seven and wrapping eleven to zero, sets twelve to five, and adjusts a running total word.

name: format_five_digit_decimal
description: Writes an unsigned value into a character buffer as decimal ASCII digits, dividing by successive powers of ten starting from ten thousand. Each digit is stored as one ASCII character.

name: format_decimal_with_divisor
description: Writes a value into a character buffer as decimal ASCII digits, using a divisor register that starts at a caller-supplied value and is divided by ten on each pass.

name: show_score_board_label
description: Advances a row counter while a threshold check fails, then writes a Score and Board label into memory and calls the text routines before returning. The threshold is a running total divided by 20000 compared with a stored level.

name: loop_until_score_board_label
description: Loops computing the same threshold and, once it is reached, writes the Score and Board label and calls the graphics move and text routines before returning. Otherwise it increments a counter and redraws a series of positions.

name: draw_grid_cell_when_occupied
description: Converts a position to a grid cell and, when the position sits on a cell boundary inside the grid and the cell is non-zero, calls a routine. The facts link the routine to a bit-map blit.

name: call_frame_draw_step
description: Makes an indirect call to a drawing routine and returns its two result registers. The facts show a frame wait wrapper and a bit-map blit among its callees.

name: blit_clipped_table_entries
description: Walks a table of eight-byte records and computes a horizontally clipped offset from a scroll-like word and each record's width. It clamps that offset to the screen width minus the record width, then calls an indirect blit with each record's position and size, stopping after a count capped at six.

name: fade_palette_in_steps
description: Steps through thirteen brightness levels, scaling each four-bit colour component of a palette table by the level divided by fifteen and offsetting it by a constant. It calls a routine to load each result and then sets a stored counter to fifteen.

name: fade_palette_out_from_twelve
description: Steps brightness from twelve down to zero, scaling each four-bit colour component of a palette table and calling a routine to load each result. It sets a flag word when a related flag is non-zero and finishes by setting a counter to fifteen.

name: fade_palette_up_to_full
description: Steps brightness from zero up to fifteen, scaling each four-bit colour component of a palette table and calling a routine to load each result. It finishes by setting a counter to fifteen.

name: fade_palette_out_framed
description: Steps brightness from fifteen down to zero, scaling each four-bit colour component of a palette table and loading each step through the graphics library colour call. It also calls a frame wait wrapper and sets a flag word when a related flag is non-zero.

name: abort_pending_io_requests
description: Calls an indirect routine repeatedly until it returns zero. The library facts show an exec abort call, so it cancels pending I/O requests.

name: wait_for_pending_io
description: Calls an indirect routine repeatedly until it returns zero. The library facts show an exec wait call, so it blocks until pending I/O requests complete.

name: reset_or_select_board_record
description: Clears a table of 68-byte records when given a sentinel key, or otherwise selects the record for that key and initialises its fields. The routine also references prompt text for a board filename and a missing-file message, and it opens, reads and closes a scores file with dos calls, drawing its text with graphics calls.

name: open_dos_library
description: Opens the dos library through an indirect open-library call and stores the returned library handle in a global word.

name: open_intuition_library
description: Opens the intuition library through an indirect open-library call and stores the returned library handle in a global word.

name: close_opened_library
description: Calls an indirect routine that the library facts identify as the exec close-library call, releasing a previously opened library handle.

name: open_graphics_library
description: Opens the graphics library through an indirect open-library call and stores the returned library handle in the global word used for later graphics calls.

name: release_library_handle
description: Calls an indirect routine that the library facts identify as the exec close-library call, releasing a library handle.

name: open_diskfont_library
description: Opens the diskfont library through an indirect open-library call and stores the returned library handle in a global word.

name: release_library_base
description: Calls an indirect routine that the library facts identify as the exec close-library call, releasing a library base.

name: open_iff_library_checked
description: Opens the iff library through an indirect call and, when the call returns zero, sets a global error pointer. The library facts include the error text for a missing iff library file.

name: close_library_via_indirect_call
description: Calls an indirect routine that the library facts identify as the exec close-library call, releasing a library handle.

name: allocate_tiered_music_buffers
description: Subtracts a fixed amount from an available-memory figure and, through a series of thresholds, lays out up to six buffer offsets. It allocates a block when enough memory is free and records each tier's start address, and the facts show dos open, read and close calls for a music file.

name: copy_block_load_scores
description: Loops over a block of longwords up to a fixed end address, writing each back to its own position. It then opens the scores file and, if the open succeeds, reads it and closes it.

name: write_scores_file
description: Opens the scores file and, if the open succeeds, writes through an indirect call and then closes the file.

name: load_iff_colour_table
description: Calls an IFF library routine that fetches a colour table and, when it fails, clears a global pointer and calls the IFF cleanup routine. The strings show the failure text for the colour table and for an invalid IFF file.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing any work. It is a single-instruction routine.

name: decode_iff_picture_or_clear
description: Calls an IFF library decode routine and, when it returns zero, clears a global pointer and calls the IFF cleanup routine. The strings show the failure text for a picture decode and an invalid IFF file.

name: open_custom_screen_or_clear
description: Opens a custom intuition screen through an indirect call and clears a global screen pointer when the open fails. The string shows the error message for a custom screen that cannot be opened.

name: open_main_window
description: Opens a window through an indirect intuition call and stores the returned window handle in a global word.

name: open_main_window_checked
description: Opens the main window through an indirect intuition call and, when the call returns zero, clears a global window pointer. The string shows the error message for a main window that cannot be opened.

name: generate_pseudo_random_number
description: Mixes several global words with exclusive-or and multiplication, advances a state word, and returns a value reduced modulo the requested range plus one. It is a pseudo-random number generator.

name: call_routine_when_word_nonzero
description: Calls one routine when a global word is non-zero and otherwise returns without action.

name: call_routine_when_selected
description: Calls one routine when a global word is non-zero and otherwise returns without action. It is identical in effect to its neighbour.

name: call_routine_return_zero
description: Calls one routine and then returns zero.

name: call_routine_pass_result
description: Calls one routine and returns its two result registers unchanged.

name: build_pointer_index_table
description: Clears four words, then scans a list of 127 bytes and builds a table of pointers with 30 entries per row. It sets state flags when the table is complete.

name: init_audio_channels_and_index
description: Clears four words and builds a pointer index table, then sets state flags. The facts show it touches the four audio channel volume registers and reads the CIA port A register, which holds the fire buttons and disk status.

name: disable_audio_channels_when_active
description: When an active flag is set, clears it and writes zero to several registers, then writes a DMA control word with one bit cleared. The facts show the audio volume and DMA control registers are touched.

name: reload_audio_channel_pointers
description: When audio is active and not held, steps a counter and, when it wraps, reloads the audio channel start-address and length registers from a table of stored values. Short delays surround the DMA enable, and a table offset advances by 16 until it reaches 1024.

name: decode_indexed_record_into_output
description: Reads a four-byte record from a source table and uses the high nibbles of its first two bytes as an index into a table of 30-byte entries. It copies fields from that entry into a destination record and stores address and value words for records whose low twelve bits are non-zero.

name: copy_record_word_to_destination
description: Copies a sixteen-bit word from a fixed offset in a record to the location pointed to by a destination register.

name: scale_volume_and_setup_channels
description: Writes a volume value into an output record, scaled from a table word by a level word and shifted down by four bits. The facts also show it touches the four audio channel start and length registers and the DMA control register.

name: compare_low_bits_to_limit
description: Takes the low twelve bits of a stored word into a second field and clears a flag when they equal a limit field. It sets the flag and returns early when the value is below the limit.

name: process_record_command_nibble
description: Reads a record's command word and, when its low twelve bits are non-zero, branches on the low nibble. A zero nibble selects a value from a table of 36 words by a counter modulo three, and a one nibble subtracts a byte from the stored value; the facts also show a read of the CIA port A register.

name: reset_then_jump_to_entry
description: Calls the system reset routine and then jumps to the address held in a global word. The facts show it is reached from the boot entry.

name: stub_idle_loop_unreached
description: Loops forever without doing any work. It is a two-instruction stub in a gap that decodes as code, so it is not a meaningful routine.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains only a decoder error marker, so the bytes at this address are not a meaningful routine.

name: allocate_and_queue_task_node
description: Allocates memory, finds the current task and adds a node to a list using exec calls. The recovered body shows only an endless loop, so the rest of its logic is not visible here.

name: free_node_when_countdown_ends
description: Calls two routines to tear down a node and decrements a countdown field. When the countdown reaches zero and a flag bit is set, it calls another routine. The facts show exec free-memory and remove-node calls.

name: finish_node_or_mark_pending
description: When a countdown field is zero, performs two cleanup calls and returns a stored result word. Otherwise it sets a pending bit in a flag byte and returns zero.

name: close_library_and_free_node
description: Calls routines that close a library and free a node's memory, then returns a stored result word from the node. The facts show exec close-library, free-memory and remove calls.

name: find_list_entry_by_key
description: Walks a list of variable-length entries, each with a length field, and returns the entry whose first longword equals the search key. It returns null when no entry matches.

name: add_eight_to_call_result
description: Calls a routine and adds eight to the value it returns. The recovered body is partial, so the other calls it makes are not visible in this evidence.

name: copy_bytes_counted
description: Copies a block of bytes from a source to a destination, one byte per step, counting down a length register until it expires.

name: copy_bytes_until_counter_expires
description: Copies bytes from a source to a destination, decrementing the length register before each copy, so a zero length copies nothing.

name: unpack_run_length_bytes
description: Decodes a run-length compressed byte stream. A non-negative control byte copies the following literal bytes, while a negative control byte repeats the next byte a set number of times, and decoding stops when the output count reaches zero.

name: unpack_fill_and_literal_runs
description: Fills a destination run with one source byte, then reads control bytes. A non-negative control copies that many literal bytes, and a negative control starts another fill, with decoding ending when the output count is used up.

name: call_single_routine_return
description: Calls a single routine and returns. The recovered body shows no further logic.

name: write_iff_ilbm_image
description: Writes an IFF ILBM image: it emits the FORM, ILBM and BMHD chunk headers, packs a table of 16-bit colour entries into three-byte groups, and writes the result through library stream calls.

name: pad_and_finish_chunk_write
description: Finishes writing a chunk. When its length is not aligned to four bytes it writes padding, then calls the stream routines to flush and close it.

name: close_stream_if_flagged
description: Calls a stream close routine when a flag register is non-zero, then calls a further routine.

name: compute_weighted_row_sums
description: Computes eight values, each a scaled term plus a table entry plus an offset, into a stack buffer. It then adds a step value to each buffer entry in turn, calling a stream routine each time and returning early if that call fails.

name: compute_weighted_row_sums_alt
description: Computes eight values, each a scaled term plus a table entry plus an offset, into a second stack buffer. It then adds a step value to each entry, calling a stream routine each time and returning early if that call fails.

name: encode_run_length_bytes
description: Encodes a byte stream into run-length packets. Runs of three or more equal bytes are written as a negative count followed by one byte, and other bytes are copied as literal blocks with a positive count.

name: encode_run_length_and_count
description: Encodes a byte stream into run-length packets, writing runs of three or more equal bytes as a negative count plus one byte and other bytes as literal blocks. It accumulates the number of output bytes in a counter that it returns.

name: encode_literal_blocks_counted
description: Writes literal blocks of up to 128 bytes, each preceded by a count, and encodes runs of three or more equal bytes. It accumulates the number of output bytes and returns that total.

name: count_equal_byte_run
description: Counts how many consecutive bytes equal the first byte at the source, stopping at the first difference, at the end of the data, or at 128 bytes. It reports the count.

name: find_node_for_current_task
description: Finds the current exec task and walks a linked list of nodes, returning the node whose stored task field matches it, or null when none matches.

name: clear_field_and_return_one
description: Calls one routine and, when a condition flag is set, clears a longword field of the target record. It then returns one.

name: store_value_in_field
description: Calls one routine and, when the input value is non-zero, stores it in a longword field at offset 18 of the target record. It then returns zero.

name: compute_edge_flag_bits
description: Returns a bit-flag word with the high bit set when a byte field is below five and a first coordinate exceeds 384, and with a second bit set when a second coordinate exceeds 279.

name: process_ilbm_chunk_rows
description: Checks that a buffer holds an ILBM form, copies four longword fields, and loops over picture rows. For each row it calls a routine chosen by a mode byte and accumulates values into a four-entry buffer.

name: unpack_three_byte_colour_entries
description: Unpacks a block of three-byte groups into 16-bit colour words by combining nibbles from each group. It returns the number of entries written, computed from the block length divided by three.

name: add_eight_to_result_alt
description: Calls a routine and adds eight to its result. It duplicates the wrapper used by a neighbouring routine.

name: allocate_and_queue_timed_node
description: When a condition flag is set, allocates a node, stores the current task identifier and a zero longword in it, and calls a list routine to queue it. It then increments a countdown word and clears a pending bit.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: Copies sixteen longwords from a fixed offset in a source block to a destination pointer when that pointer is non-null, then calls an indirect routine. The routine it calls is the one that finds the maximum value in a linked list.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:0000
name: program_entry_clear_and_start
description: Program entry point that clears a block of 200 longwords and saves a library base and a pointer. It calls a routine when a flag bit is set, then calls a library routine and branches on its result.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:0012
name: allocate_buffer_and_init
description: Calls an indirect allocator for a 1005-unit buffer and returns 100 as an error code when it fails. On success it copies data from two stored pointers into the buffer, releases it, and returns zero.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:0070
name: xor_scramble_buffer_bytes
description: Walks a buffer of 619 bytes and exclusive-ors each byte with the sum of its index and the buffer's first byte.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:00A0
name: copy_block_into_allocated_buffer
description: Allocates a 1005-unit buffer and, when that succeeds, copies 620 bytes into it, releases the buffer and calls a routine.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:00E2
name: stage_block_then_set_state
description: Sets a state byte to one, allocates a 1006-unit buffer and copies 620 bytes into it when allocation succeeds, then releases it. It sets the state byte to four and calls a routine with the value 20000.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:013E
name: store_word_then_set_colours
description: Stores a word at a fixed offset, then sets sixteen colour registers to the same value of seven in each component through an indirect colour call. It finishes by calling a display update routine.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:0140
name: set_sixteen_colour_entries
description: Sets sixteen colour registers to the same value of seven in each component through an indirect colour call, then calls a display update routine.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:0180
name: draw_outline_shape_at_point
description: Draws a fixed eight-segment outline at a given position and size. It chooses a pen colour from the sign of its vertical argument and draws each segment with pen, move and draw calls to the rendering library.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:037E
name: draw_four_fixed_shapes
description: Clears the rendering area through an indirect call, then draws four shapes at fixed positions and sizes using the outline routine.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:03EA
name: draw_hall_of_fame_table
description: Draws the title ABYSS HALL OF FAME, then loops over ten entries, drawing each row through a row routine. It changes pen and drawing mode before the fourth entry and finishes by writing a sixteen-character buffer to the rastport.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:04DE
name: draw_hall_of_fame_row
description: Draws one table row: a rank label that is blank for the first nine entries, a value formatted from the nibbles of a stored word, and a seven-character name field right-aligned by its measured width.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:068A
name: insert_hall_of_fame_entry
description: Finds the rank where a new score belongs in a ten-entry table, shifts lower entries down, and copies a 21-byte name into the freed slot. It stores the score with a high flag bit set when a marker byte equals twenty.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:07FA
name: draw_hall_of_fame_rows
description: Sets the pen and drawing mode, draws a header from its two arguments, and loops over ten entries drawing each through the row routine. It finishes by writing a sixteen-character buffer to the rastport.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:089C
name: draw_rank_row_fixed_columns
description: Draws a rank label that is blank for the first nine entries, then a value at column 100 and a three-character field at column 170. It uses text positioning and text calls for each part.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:095A
name: poll_input_until_selection
description: Draws a row, then repeatedly reads messages from a port through an indirect call, replying to each one, until a state byte clears. It returns the current selection value when the loop ends.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:0AB8
name: read_name_entry_keys
description: Clears a 20-character name buffer to spaces, then reads key codes, ignoring one group of special codes. Each remaining key is matched against a 61-character table of allowed characters.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:0E10
name: stub_return_only
description: Returns immediately without doing any work. It is a single-instruction routine in a gap of unreached code.

name: drain_message_port_replies
description: Repeatedly takes messages from a port through an indirect call and replies to each one until none remain.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:0E3C
name: wait_for_message_value
description: Waits for a message on a port, pausing between checks. It then replies to the message and returns a word field taken from it.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:0E7E
name: open_display_and_load_palette
description: Allocates a display structure and opens a view, loading sixteen palette entries from a stored table and clearing a region. It returns 100 when an allocation fails, and the facts show DMA control and a custom chip register are touched.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:0F48
name: draw_moment_message_panel
description: Clears the rastport, draws a panel at fixed coordinates, and writes a text message beginning MOMENT with a sixteen-character buffer.

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:285C

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:2A66
name: randomise_thirteen_entry_pointers

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:2B1A
name: advance_timed_state_machine

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:2B9A

name: blit_three_segment_sprite

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:337C
name: setup_blitter_for_sprite_part

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:390A

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:4154
name: copy_four_regions_into_buffer

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:4382

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:46F8

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:4D4C

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:4D70

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:50B2

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:51DC

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:524A

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:54A8

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:556C

key: abyss (1991)(free spirit software)[cr skr]/Abyss (1991)(Free Spirit Software)[cr SKR].adf:Main:0:58BC
